intervention.description: Enforce crop-residue & open-waste burning ban across the upwind belt
intervention.ward: Upwind agricultural belt + Ward 12 (Sarai Kale Khan)

impact.method: WHO AirQ+ log-linear CRF (short-term); ΔCases = y0·Pop·(1−e^(−βΔC))·days

citations.source: WHO HRAPIE (2013), all-cause (natural) mortality, short-term PM2.5, all ages
World Bank / SRS — India crude death rate, ~2021

citations.unit: ₹ per premature death (Value of a Statistical Life)
citations.source: Benefit transfer from OECD (2012) base VSL (USD 3.0M, 2005) via income elasticity 0.8; consistent with World Bank (2016) 'The Cost of Air Pollution'
citations.caveat: VSL estimates for India span ~₹3–12 crore; ₹5 crore is a conservative mid-point — treat the ₹ figure as order-of-magnitude, not precise

citations.source: VayuNetra metro-cell heuristic; WorldPop-refined population is Stage-2 E2
citations.caveat: flat heuristic — refine with WorldPop for ward-accurate counts

citations.source: Derived from Andreae (2019), Atmos. Chem. Phys. — agricultural-residue burning EFs (CO₂ ≈ 1515 g/kg, PM2.5 ≈ 9.1 g/kg)
citations.caveat: field-burning average; real ratio varies with crop & combustion efficiency
